errors.evidence: This part of the description introduces context from the paper's caption ('Betroffenheit der Betriebe von der Mindestlohnanhebung auf 12 Euro...'), which is not present in the image itself. The image title is simply 'Anteil an allen Betrieben in %' (Share of all companies in %).

errors.text_span: in alphabetischer Reihenfolge von oben nach unten auf
errors.evidence: The categories in the first section of the chart (the industries) are not sorted alphabetically. They are sorted in descending order based on their percentage value. For example, 'Gastgewerbe' (G) comes before 'Nahrungs- und Genussmittel' (N), which comes before 'Einzelhandel' (E).

This is an over-generalization. While many bars represent industries ('Branche'), the chart also includes four bars representing company sizes ('Betriebsgrößen'), which the description itself mentions later.
The bar for 'Baugewerbe' indicates a value of approximately 8%, not 11%. It is the shortest bar among the industry categories.
The bar for 'Kleinstbetriebe' ends exactly at the 20% mark on the x-axis, not 25%.

errors.text_span: die Reihenfolge der Branchen ist alphabetisch
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of a previous error. The industries are sorted by value in descending order, not alphabetically.
